title: Place the open mark in the upper right corner of the card
goal: uses the relatively positioned container as a reference to place the absolutely positioned child element in the specified corner.
summary: branch card is currently squeezed under the opening hours. Move it to the upper right corner of the card so readers can see it at a glance.
tasks: Set position: relative to .branch-card as the positioning reference for the branch card.
Use position: absolute to place the .branch-badge so that it is 10px from the top and 12px from the right side of the card.

example.note: cover uses .album-cover as the positioning reference and is affixed to its lower left corner.

hint: Add position: relative to the parent container, and the corner marker can be positioned relative to the card. When this sentence is left out, it could run all the way to the upper right corner of the page.
